rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; i1040sd p. 13, Unrecaptured Section 1250 Gain Worksheet, line 1: "If you have a section 1250 property in Part III of Form 4797 for which you made an entry in Part I of Form 4797 (but not on Form 6252), enter the smaller of line 22 or line 24 of Form 4797 for that property". Form 4797 is refused by sd.other_forms ("Are there gains or losses from (or that belong on) Forms 4797, 2439, 6252, 4684, 6781 or 8824, or capital gains or losses on a Schedule K-1? ...") and by scope.schedule1 ("... sales of business property (Form 4797); ... partnerships, S corporations, estates or trusts (Schedule E or a Schedule K-1) ...") (checked: sd.other_forms true on classm.g28.2 gives sd.line7, sd.line14, g28.line5, g28.line7, u1250.line16, u1250.line18 and f1040.line7a refused); with no Form 4797 line 7 gain the page says to skip lines 1 through 9 (i1040sd p. 13: "If you aren’t reporting a gain on Form 4797, line 7, skip lines 1 through 9 and go to line 10."), and a zero on a skipped line is permitted. The refusal sits on Schedule D and the sale, not on this line's derivation, so the rendered English the reviewer saw did not name it. The line is shown only when Schedule D line 17 is Yes (BUG-0183), which the reviewer did not contest. No change to the data.

rulings.model: IRS line 11 requires the total of unrecaptured section 1250 gain reported on Schedule K-1, Form 1099-DIV, or Form 2439, or in connection with Form 1099-R; the restatement uses only Form 1099-DIV box 2b.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; i1040sd p. 13, Unrecaptured Section 1250 Gain Worksheet, line 11: "Enter the total of any amounts reported to you as “unrecaptured section 1250 gain” on a Schedule K-1, Form 1099-DIV, or Form 2439 from an estate, a trust, a real estate investment trust, or a mutual fund (or other regulated investment company) or in connection with a Form 1099-R". Within scope line 11 is Form 1099-DIV box 2b alone (i1040sd p. 2: "If there is an amount in box 2b, include that amount on line 11 of the Unrecaptured Section 1250 Gain Worksheet in these instructions if you complete line 19 of Schedule D."). Schedule K-1 and Form 2439 amounts are refused by sd.other_forms ("Are there gains or losses from (or that belong on) Forms 4797, 2439, 6252, 4684, 6781 or 8824, or capital gains or losses on a Schedule K-1? ...") (checked: sd.other_forms true on classm.g28.2 gives sd.line7, sd.line14, g28.line5, g28.line7, u1250.line16, u1250.line18 and f1040.line7a refused); a Form 1099-R lump-sum distribution by retirement.special ("a lump-sum distribution you may report on Form 4972"), which refuses that distribution. Whether retirement.special covers every 1099-R source of unrecaptured section 1250 gain is not settled by these pages (the Form 1099-R case is not explained on i1040sd p. 13); no 1099-R input reaches this worksheet in the project. The refusal sits on Schedule D and the sale, not on this line's derivation, so the rendered English the reviewer saw did not name it. The line is shown only when Schedule D line 17 is Yes (BUG-0183), which the reviewer did not contest. No change to the data.

rulings.model: IRS line 16 includes long-term capital loss carryovers from Schedule D, line 14 and Schedule K-1 (Form 1041), box 11, code D; the restatement uses only sd line 14.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; i1040sd p. 13, Unrecaptured Section 1250 Gain Worksheet, line 16: "Enter your long-term capital loss carryovers from Schedule D, line 14; and Schedule K-1 (Form 1041), box 11, code D". Printed "16. ( )". The Schedule D line 14 part is the representation the page asks: since Stage 20 the line copies Schedule D line 14, held negative, and line 17 combines lines 14 through 16 (constructed return: 2024 Schedule D line 15 -$10,000 and line 21 $3,000, box 2d $400, line 17 Yes: line 16 -$10,000.00, line 14 $400.00, line 17 $9,600.00, line 18 $0.00). A Schedule K-1 (Form 1041) box 11 code D carryover is a capital loss on a Schedule K-1, refused by sd.other_forms ("Are there gains or losses from (or that belong on) Forms 4797, 2439, 6252, 4684, 6781 or 8824, or capital gains or losses on a Schedule K-1? ...") and scope.schedule1 ("... sales of business property (Form 4797); ... partnerships, S corporations, estates or trusts (Schedule E or a Schedule K-1) ..."); sd.line14 itself refuses on sd.other_forms (checked: sd.other_forms true on classm.g28.2 gives sd.line7, sd.line14, g28.line5, g28.line7, u1250.line16, u1250.line18 and f1040.line7a refused). The project's English says so ("is refused by the Schedule D screen"). The refusal sits on Schedule D and the sale, not on this line's derivation, so the rendered English the reviewer saw did not name it. The line is shown only when Schedule D line 17 is Yes (BUG-0183), which the reviewer did not contest. No change to the data.
